content.text: [Email ir-team@investor.example → lena.fischer@veritascloud.de Sat Mar 08 10:00 CET 2026] Subject: GDPR Due Diligence — Art. 30 RoPA Submission. Noted. The IR team has attached the 2022 legacy RoPA v0 and asked if it is still current. I will advise the DPO that the v0 file is superseded and the current v1 draft should be completed and provided after remediation of the identified gaps.
